request.style: English, dark acoustic ballad, aching intimate male vocal, nylon-string guitar, cello, low piano, distant choir pad, sorrowful and still, 62 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They came out to the garden when the Passover was through
The olive trees were silver and the night was cold and blue
He took Peter and the brothers and he walked a little way
Then he fell down on his face and he began to pray

[Chorus]
My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me
Yet not as I will, but as you will
Not my will, but yours be done

[Verse]
He came back to the others and he found them fast asleep
Their eyes were heavy with the night, too heavy now to keep
So you could not keep watch with me for even one hour?
He asked them in the garden while the night held all its power

[Pre-Chorus]
Keep watch and pray that you may not fall into temptation
The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak

[Chorus]
My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me
Yet not as I will, but as you will
Not my will, but yours be done

[Verse]
An angel came from heaven and it strengthened him to stand
His sweat became like drops of blood that fell upon the land
He prayed a second time and then he prayed a third
And every time he knelt to pray he prayed the same words

[Bridge]
My Father, if this cannot pass unless I drink it
Your will be done
Get up, let us go
Look, my betrayer is here

[Chorus]
My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me
Yet not as I will, but as you will
Not my will, but yours be done

[Outro]
Not my will, but yours be done
